dslRule:
<!id: remove.byteArrayInputStream.from.filesystemresourcemanager.write>
<!description: Replace FileSystemResourceManager.write(..., new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), ...) with FileSystemResourceManager.write(..., bytes, ...).>
<!severity: INFO>
org.eclipse.core.internal.localstore.FileSystemResourceManager.write($file, new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream($bytes$), $fileInfo, $updateFlags, $append, $monitor)
=>
org.eclipse.core.internal.localstore.FileSystemResourceManager.write($file, $bytes$, $fileInfo, $updateFlags, $append, $monitor)
;;
summary: Commit 1: Replace ByteArrayInputStream creation with direct byte[] argument for a specific method call to 'FileSystemResourceManager.write'.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
